# Proxied-server cmd test shard manifest.
#
# Format: <total_shards> <shard_number> <top_level_test_name>
#
# 15-shard split, bin-packed longest-processing-time-first by
# estimated cost (bd-init count; per-init migration chains dominate), as of
# the test set that existed when this block was last generated.
# Regenerating it (scripts/ci/gen_proxied_shard_manifest.py 15 --write) is
# deliberately NOT part of normal maintenance: this block is frozen for
# pr-risk.yml's/main.yml's legacy fork/push jobs (see engdocs/TESTING.md),
# so every TestProxiedServer*/TestServerMode* function added since it was
# last generated hash-distributes via proxied-test-shard.sh (cksum(name) %
# total) instead of being explicitly listed here. Only reweight it on
# purpose, and expect the shard assignments below to change substantially
# if you do (a fresh run packs every currently-discovered test, not just
# the ones already listed here).
#
# Deliberate exception (Oct 2026): four tests that had been hash-placed
# onto the two shards closest to the 15m -test.timeout are pinned here
# by hand, onto shards whose measured CI job time was lowest; nothing
# that was already listed moved. TestProxiedServerStorageClass and
# TestProxiedServerServeRefusesAStaleCheckpointWithGone (discovered
# from #7129 on) had hashed onto shard 5, which then hit the timeout on
# most Main runs; pinning them returns shard 5 to its earlier test set.
# TestProxiedServerListComments and
# TestProxiedServerServeRefusesAStreamOnADisabledJournal had hashed
# onto shard 3, which runs within about a minute of the timeout. An
# incremental --write keeps pinned lines where they are; a pin is a
# reviewed choice, not a regeneration of this block.
#
# TestProxiedServerOutageReconnectAcceptanceMatrix is pinned to shard 1
# (the lightest in recent Main runs, ~6.5 min) instead of hashing onto
# shard 14, which already runs ~13.5 min of the 15m timeout. These jobs
# have no socat, so today it skips here; the pin keeps shard 14 safe if
# socat is ever installed.
#
# TestProxiedServerClose3 (shard 13) and TestProxiedServerClose4 (shard 2)
# are the two parents gastownhall/beads#7173 split off TestProxiedServerClose
# to pull shard 5 (15m+) back under the timeout, pinned onto the two
# lightest shards of that PR's own run other than shard 5 itself (6m51s
# and 7m57s; shard 5 ran 5m50s only because their 12 subtests had just
# left it, and putting Close3 back would recreate most of the set that
# timed out) rather than hashed; the lines are listed under their shards
# like every other pin.
#
# This file is generated: notes added here are erased by the next
# regeneration. Add them to the generator instead. Known blind spots
# of the cost proxy (it counts inits, not the work done per init):
#
#   TestProxiedServerListSortRetiresTheWalk is the most expensive
#   entry and one of the cheapest-looking: off a single init it seeds
#   1400 rows and walks the listing three ways. It is the measurement
#   behind the claim that sort=priority retires the client-side walk,
#   so it has to run on PRs.
#
#   TestProxiedServerServeReadParity is the CLI/HTTP read parity
#   oracle, the behavioural half of the anti-drift claim. It being in
#   this lane, and this lane being required by the PR Risk CI gate,
#   is what makes that claim enforced on PRs rather than asserted in
#   a doc comment.

# Proxied-server cmd test shard manifest.
#
# Format: <total_shards> <shard_number> <top_level_test_name>
#
# 34-shard split for the Bazel-only proxied-server tier
# (bazel-proxied in .github/workflows/bazel.yml), bin-packed
# longest-processing-time-first by measured wall-time from
# scripts/ci/proxied_test_durations.json (see that file for
# provenance and its "relative weight, not absolute SLA" caveat).
# Regenerate with scripts/ci/gen_proxied_shard_manifest.py 34
# --weights=duration --write after adding or removing
# TestProxiedServer*/TestServerMode* functions. --write is incremental:
# it keeps every already-assigned test on its current shard and only
# places newly-discovered names, onto whichever shard is currently
# lightest, so two unrelated PRs that each add one test do not textually
# conflict or silently invalidate each other's packing. Pass --repack to
# force a full from-scratch rebalance instead (a deliberate, separate
# change — expect a large diff). --check only verifies every discovered
# name is listed here exactly once (no stale or duplicate entries); it
# does NOT verify the packing is still well-balanced, so a reweighted
# proxied_test_durations.json does not by itself fail --check — rerun
# with --repack periodically (or whenever shard loads look uneven in CI)
# to rebalance on purpose. Newly-added tests not listed here
# hash-distribute via proxied-test-shard.sh: cksum(name) % total,
# unrelated to proxied_test_durations.json (that file only feeds this
# generator's own cost estimate for a test it has not measured yet).
#
# This file is generated: notes added here are erased by the next
# regeneration. Add them to the generator or the durations file
# instead.
